scope: Cross-review retained/held worker4 rows and worker5 provisional rice objective against pending 80 questions
method: Global lexical scan of all 80 full question objects; direct semantic inspection of nearest relevant stems/options/reasons and original objective rows. No fresh PDF inspection.

rows.reasonEn: None of the pending 80 stems/options/reasons tests independence of roof cross-section and number of connected spans. Retain only as a candidate; topic-specific source hold and original page inspection remain unresolved.

No direct match among pending 80. Distinguishing eaves height from ridge height needs source-supported distinct visual task and original illustration; an abstract measurement-location substitution does not establish capacity.

No pending 80 item specifically assesses heating versus condensation/humidity. Existing baseline humidity/environment-control questions still create a construct boundary issue; source gives no operating prescription. Preserve hold.

Pending 80 has no fruit bagging-versus-thinning item. However both existing action definitions and purposes are already exposed in baseline questions. A simple recombination does not prove a new ability; require distinct decision and source check.
No pending 80 item concerns fastening peach fruit bags. Crop substitution from grape bag positioning/fastener questions is insufficient; source and original visual sequence remain required.

Pending 80 adds no high-grafting/renewal item, but baseline already distinguishes new-tree replanting and high grafting definitions/purposes; reversing the same comparison is not a new atomic objective.

No pending 80 item evaluates representative-fruit sampling versus whole-crop guarantee. Candidate may be distinct from instrument matching, but inherited lesson prose and generic qualification alone do not certify source-backed sampling competence.

The pending question directly asks tillage and puddling before flooded direct sowing, the exact proposed atomic objective. Its four choices/reasons also distinguish sparse planting, transplanting and dry-field sequence. Do not count it again even before publication.
